name: Acolytes at the Altar
story: The altar answers pain with changes, and the acolytes cannot stop asking.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Acolytes kneel in a circle and cut their own hands, then wait for the answer.

beforeStory.speaker: Acolyte
beforeStory.text: The god only answers the hurt. Give it something, or let us.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The altar goes quiet. One acolyte writes down what it answered.

name: What the Wound Asks
story: The wound is a question. The priest will ask it until it is answered.

beforeStory.speaker: Priest
beforeStory.text: You are already carrying an answer. Let me open it.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The altar has been fed all day. The priest is not asking permission.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith keeps his hand shut until the priest stops asking.

name: The Answer Given
story: The priest offers to write Arith's answer himself.

beforeStory.speaker: Priest
beforeStory.text: Give me the name of the thing you want changed, and I will change it.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Mara is left at the courtyard wall. The altar will not answer in front of her.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith speaks once. The altar writes it down and hands the page back.

afterStory.speaker: Priest
afterStory.text: There. Now the change is yours.

name: The Understudy's Line
story: The gallery keeps performing a play nobody finished.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: An understudy waits in the wings for an entrance that was never written.

beforeStory.speaker: Gallery Guide
beforeStory.text: Stand where the light is. The play goes on from there.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The guide marks the script. The understudy takes the line.

name: The Last Entrance
story: The last entrance is blocked by everyone who wanted it.

beforeStory.speaker: Gallery Guide
beforeStory.text: There were three of us at every door. Now there are four.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The last entrance is narrow. Everyone in the gallery is standing in it.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The door opens. The gallery keeps the understudies.

name: No One Left to Play
story: The play needs an end, and the audience will not provide one.

beforeStory.speaker: Gallery Guide
beforeStory.text: No scripts, no skills. Just the last scene, as written.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The stage is lit for a cast that has already left.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The stage empties. The guide bows to nobody in particular.

afterStory.speaker: Gallery Guide
afterStory.text: Take the line with you. Someone will ask for it.
